# Rhēma — build ledger (machine state)

> **OPERATING MODE.** Fresh session resume prompt: read `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` first, then this
> `CURRENT STATE` block and `docs/tickets/00_MANIFEST.md § The chain`. The build is a stacked PR chain driven by
> orchestrate-build (round 4 onward — `dispatch: subagent`, one ticket = one fresh sub-context); `implement-spec`
> reads the next chain row, forks from the current branch, and closes its own ticket here (D4). A pending milestone gate (G1) is **not** a block — it is
> a gate ahead of `nextTicket`. Never guess a gate past; never let a code ticket block on a HUMAN row.
